title: Gragna the Cursed
summary: Aid the Gukta rescue force against Gragna while staying inside the battle area.
overview: Gragna appears after the Cursed Spore stage. Follow the Knight of Gukta's call toward the next chamber and keep Gragna inside that encounter area.
Every 65 seconds while engaged, the script announces the four healers and casts Mithaniel's Blessing at Gragna's current hate leader.

abilities.name: Mithaniel's Blessing
abilities.summary: A repeating 65-second spell targets the current hate leader.

abilities.name: Encounter boundary
abilities.summary: Pulling Gragna west of X -380 resets the fight.
description: A six-second check casts Balance of the Nameless on Gragna, removes buffs, returns Gragna home and clears the hate list.
